prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high-fidelity MOBILE APP UI DESIGN REFERENCE for an actual Android fashion-design companion app named "atelier". This is the design source to be faithfully implemented in code, not a promotional poster.
Show THREE full-height portrait mobile screens side by side on a subtle warm taupe background. All screens the same size, flat front-facing, straight-on, no perspective, no hands, no bulky phone hardware. Wide landscape canvas. Each screen has a restrained dark status bar and an elegant bottom tab navigation with icons and short labels.
Visual direction: a quiet independent fashion atelier, sophisticated editorial design, warm ivory #F8F5EE, charcoal #292923, muted rust #A85438, pale olive accent, fine warm-gray rules, beautiful serif display headlines paired with highly legible sans-serif controls. Generous yet usable spacing, subtly rounded cards, no purple gradients, no glass effects.
Screen 1: STUDIO home. Wordmark "atelier" with a tiny rust dot top left, small round profile top right. Small eyebrow "YOUR DESIGN STUDIO"; large elegant title "Make it yours." A large editorial product photograph of a sand canvas tote bag with brown leather handles, set against warm pale paper. Under photo label "Everyday tote" and small metadata "36 × 32 × 12 cm". Full width rust button "+ New design". Below a small section "Recent designs" with a smaller card showing an ivory linen shirt. Bottom navigation "Studio", "Library", "Materials", studio selected.
Screen 2: DESIGN DETAIL. Back arrow, title "Everyday tote", minimal overflow icon. Segmented control "Design" and "Pattern". Large square beautiful matching tote photo, with a tiny pill "CONCEPT". Below elegant heading "Made to measure." Three aligned numeric fields labeled "Width", "Height", "Depth", values "36", "32", "12" and suffix cm. Color swatches cream rust charcoal. Sticky rust button "See estimate" above bottom navigation.
Screen 3: ESTIMATE. Back arrow, title "Production estimate". Tiny image thumbnail next to "Everyday tote" and "1 piece". A calm dark olive charcoal cost card with small ivory label "ESTIMATED TOTAL", very large "₩83,000" in cream, tiny "Materials + making". A section "Material plan" with separate airy list rows for "Canvas" / "0.90 m", "Lining" / "0.40 m", "Hardware" / "1 set". Fine dividers and small rust sample dots. Short understated note "Estimate based on your dimensions." Bottom pair of clearly tappable buttons "Save design" filled rust and "Find a maker" outline. Bottom navigation consistent with other screens.
Make each screen look like a carefully designed production-ready mobile app with coherent typography, realistic tappable controls, impeccable alignment, restrained luxury. Exact English text wherever specified, no extraneous titles outside the screens.

supportingAssets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Input image is a STYLE AND SUBJECT REFERENCE, not an edit target. Recreate ONLY the beautiful canvas tote product photograph visible in the supplied atelier mobile UI reference, as a standalone asset for that app. No UI, phones, border, text, logos, measurements, diagrams or labels. Square composition. Premium natural sand oatmeal cotton canvas tote with warm dark brown leather handles attached by subtle brass rivets. Match the bag and quiet artisan aesthetic in the reference as closely as possible. Full bag including both entire handles visible, front three-quarter view. Warm ivory plaster studio background extending seamlessly edge to edge, small stone vase with delicate dried stems far on the left margin, bag centered with generous breathing room: whole bag occupies middle 68% width and 73% height, ample clear margin above handle tips and below base. Soft window light from upper left, realistic woven canvas texture, warm muted cream and brown palette. Product standing on a continuous beige stone surface. Frame for a mobile hero image which will crop square to slightly landscape 1.13:1; keep bag fully inside the central region so no handles or base get cut off. Photorealistic editorial still life, visually consistent with the supplied reference.
